# 1,200.00 USD into B at 1.40: 1,000.00 from C, which holds exactly that, and
# 200.00 charged to card 2 — a transfer and a borrowing in one transaction.
#
# The held side rises by 200.00 more than it falls, and the owed side rises by
# 200.00, as a transfer out of an account holding less than it sends does. But
# no account here crosses zero: C ends at nothing and the borrowing is card
# 2's. It is a transfer sharing a transaction with an arrival, and nothing in
# it says which of B's 1,200.00 moved and which arrived, so it is refused, as
# such a transfer always was.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "1,200.00 USD into B, from C and card 2"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD C -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-1400.00"
	Liabilities:USD Card 2 -200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-280.00"
	Assets:USD B 1200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "1680.00"
